$comment: The wire contract between a BlindAI control plane and any client that carries an identity
token. Machine-readable because it is checked, not read: the control plane asserts against
this file in tests/control_plane/test_flag.py, and each client repo runs the same assertion
against its own constant. That is what makes this the source of truth rather than a fourth
It exists because the header name lived in three places — control_plane/enforcement.py and
two SDK modules — kept in step by one test and a comment reading 'all three must change
together'. That test could only run where all three were importable, which is to say in the
monorepo, which is exactly where the clients were about to stop living. Deleting the monorepo
SDK copies without moving the constant first would have deleted the only thing checking it.
LICENCE: this file is Apache-2.0 material under the line the user drew on 2026-09-14 —
manifest format, runtime registration protocol, identity token claims and verification rules,
decision record schema are public; resolution, composition, exception semantics and anything
that DECIDES stay BSL 1.1 in the monorepo. Nothing that decides is described here: a header
name and a claim set tell you how to present a token, never what it will be permitted to do.
When the specs repo is created this file moves there verbatim and the monorepo consumes it.

$header_comment: The HTTP header carrying the identity token. A client sends it only when it holds a token;
absent is a valid state and must not be sent empty, because an empty header and a missing
one reach the route as different things.

meanings.iss: isolation space id — the signing authority, and the JWKS to verify against
meanings.path: the space's path in the tree

optional.mf: whether the runtime was manifested when the token was minted (spec 4); absent on tokens minted before it, and a verifier treats absent as false
optional.al: the agent's autonomy level when the token was minted: autonomous, supervised or manual; read only on the degraded identity path, absent on tokens minted before it, and a verifier treats absent as autonomous
